lede: Tulsa carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.5 against +1.5, a 0.1-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Tulsa +7.6 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with North Texas winning 69% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is pass defense, where Tulsa leads North Texas by 95 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 72% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
